rule.dmg.easy: Each piece in the group takes {a} health from the rival, and each piece beyond the third takes {b} more: a group of 3 is worth {v3}, of 4 is worth {v4}, of 5 is worth {v5}. Spinning to build a bigger group pays off.
rule.dmg.hard: Each piece takes 1 health from the opponent of whoever receives it, or {a} if it is on an altar. Each piece beyond the third is worth {b} more.
rule.altars.hard: The pieces of a group go to whoever fired, except those on an altar: on the golden face everything is yours and on the red one everything is the rival's.
rule.cards: You start the battle with 5 cards of equipment of gods and heroes, drawn from your deck. Each has a mythology and a color and costs power mana: only a god of that mythology with a power of that color can pay, with the mana from the bar of that power (if more than one can pay, you choose). It works once and does not use your turn. Using god powers fills a bar that draws more cards from the deck. Some effects are immediate (swap altar pieces, heal), some last a few turns (more damage, protection, draining the rival's mana) and some last the whole battle. The rarer, the stronger: common (white), uncommon (green), rare (blue), epic (purple) and legendary (gold).

rule.shop: In a Run, each win gives gold, and after the reward comes a shop with 3 cards and 3 runes. A bought card goes to your collection. Runes work once, in the next encounter: mana, critical chance, protection or health in the next battle, or better cards or cards of one mythology in the next reward. You carry up to {n} runes, and leftover gold is lost when the run ends.

rule.event: Sometimes, between the reward and the shop, an event shows up: trade health for a rare card, burn a card from your deck for gold, take gold with a curse, drink from a spring, bet or bless a card. Events only change the run; nothing leaves your collection.
rule.obj: Some cards only show up in rewards, the shop and events after you complete an objective: win a run, win with each god, beat elite rivals or level up a card. The list is on the preparation screen.

rule.elite: After winning your first run, before each floor you choose between the normal rival and the elite one. The elite has +{hp}% health, +{dmg}% damage and plays better; in return it gives more gold and an offer of 4 cards with a rare or better guaranteed. Beating the boss lets you pick an epic or legendary card.

rule.run: In Run mode you face {n} rivals in a row, each stronger, the last one a boss. Before starting you pick 3 gods and build a deck of 10 to 15 cards from your collection. After each win you recover {heal}% of your health and pick 1 of 3 cards: it goes to your collection, which stays for later runs, and you decide whether to use it in this one. Repeated cards become copies that raise the card level (up to 5) during preparation. If you lose, the run ends but the collection stays. The run is saved and resumed like a battle.
rule.crit: Now and then a colorless piece with a star comes in. It counts as any color: it joins a line of 3 or more and the group deals critical damage, double the normal amount. The piece vanishes when the group is fired. The rival gets them too; each side's chance is set in Settings.
